sections.title: 3 Specific requirements
sections.text_preview:
The specific requirements are labelled as follows:

Need: Essential, Non-Essential:1,2,3

Stability: Stable, Unstable

(Source: Reference, Person, Group)

sections.title: 3.1Capability requirements
sections.text_preview:
CMA\_PE\_1 Essential, 1, Stable

The CMA shall be able to process digital signals from RPC chambers FE or from a CMA trigger output.

sections.title: CMA\_PE\_2 Essential, 1, Stable
sections.text_preview: The CMA shall be programmable and able to perform the low-pt or the high-pt algorithms. The low-pt algorithm shall use information from two doublets, while the high-pt will use one doublet plus one CM

sections.title: CMA\_PE\_3 Essential, 1, Stable
sections.text_preview: The CMA shall perform one trigger algorithm (low-pt or high-pt), for three independent programmable Pt thresholds.

sections.title: CMA\_PE\_4 Essential, 1, Stable
sections.text_preview: The latency of the CMA trigger pipeline shall be as short as possible and shall not exceed 2 BC periods, measured from signal input to trigger output buffers.

sections.title: CMA\_PE\_5Essential, 1, Stable CMA PE 5Essential, 1, Stable
sections.text_preview:
The trigger latency of the CMA shall be fixed, not depending on the amount of incoming data.

CMA\_PE\_6Essential, 1, Stable

The CMA shall be able to perform the data readout of RPC chambers

CMA\_PE

sections.title: CMA\_PE\_10 Essential, 1, Stable
sections.text_preview:
The CMA shall be able to flag internal malfunction, due for example to SEUs, on dedicated output lines.

Note 1: a PLL unlock signal is a tipical example.

sections.title: 3.2 Constraints requirements
sections.text_preview:
CMA\_GE\_1 Essential, 2, Unstable

the maximum power dissipation of the CMA per input channel shall not exceed 5 mW (1W total).

Note 1: max power value has to be checked against cooling system tests.

sections.title: CMA\_RO\_1 Essential, 1, Unstable

sections.text_preview: In the operation described in CMA\_RO\_1, it must be possible to send information for several consecutive bunch crossings around the triggered one, the extent of the time frame shall be programmable u

sections.title: CMA\_RO\_7 Essential, 1, Stable
sections.text_preview:
the CMA shall be able to accept two different LVL1\_A which are separated by a minimum interval of 3 BCs, i.e. two consecutive LVL1\_A will be separated by a time inter-

val of at least 2 BC periods.
